purpose: Bind the eventual BR204 FULL178 compact certificate to exact L>8/K8-tail-slot evidence in the same (b,d-band) traversal, so BR205 can be decided without persisting raw states or rerunning completed bands merely for attribution.

tail_slot_semantics.L_gt_8_state: compact BC state with more than eight exact qBC levels
tail_slot_semantics.K8_tail_slot: for L>8, K8 parts 1..7 are exact and part 8 contains exact level 8 plus every deeper-level multiplicity evaluated at q8
tail_slot_semantics.warning: tail-slot multiplicity is not identical to multiplicity from levels strictly greater than 8; the L>8 state predicate is what localizes possible K8-vs-FULL slack

parent_union_requirements: prove exact coverage/disjointness of all 250 expected (b,d-band) units
prove every admissible even d is covered exactly once for each b
count static H96 refined-state/assignment-mass data once per b after cross-band equality validation
sum every dynamic attribution field exactly across all 250 subunits
retain deterministic per-subunit stream digests and one global bin-stream digest
solve one exact rational LP only after unioning all subunit capacities
group equal exact s/B ratios before forced-tail computation so tail activity cannot depend on bin ordering

BR205_gate_semantics.bounded_half: PASS_PREPARATORY_EVIDENCE: deeper qBC strictly improves the identical bounded population and all bounded K8-vs-FULL slack is localized to L>8
BR205_gate_semantics.full178_raw_half_candidate: positive exact FULL178 L>8 base/mass evidence plus positive K8 L>8 and tail-slot raw objective contribution
BR205_gate_semantics.full178_stronger_candidate: raw half candidate plus positive forced-selected tail-slot capacity after equal-ratio classes are merged in the exact global mu LP
BR205_gate_semantics.promotion_rule: Neither candidate authorizes BR205 until the BR204 heavy result is hostile-audited and the transition is explicitly recorded.

execution.storage_rule: Per-subunit gzip hard cap is 900,000 bytes; rollover peak uses at most one prior recovery union plus one re-emitted prefix before fail-closed cleanup.
execution.resume_recovery: Generation >=2 names the immediately prior failed/cancelled/timed-out heavy run. Its prefix plus completed subunits are validated and re-emitted before missing-only computation.
execution.launcher_trigger: A dedicated runkey-only push on stage32bridge-mainbatch starts heavy only after the audited-parent authorization gate passes; no user workflow_dispatch is required.

subunit_invariants: approved d bands are 8..54, 56..100, 102..146, 148..192 and are disjoint
only bands containing at least one admissible d>=2b are durable units, giving exactly 250 units
static BC state/mass/tail metadata are identical across retained bands of the same b and are counted once per b
all dynamic attribution fields are computed in the same streamed (b,d-band) unit before raw state data are discarded
all L<=8 states are exact under K8 and therefore have zero K8-vs-FULL truncation slack by construction
mu attribution is a subset of the corresponding K8 attribution
